# Repository security audit — 2026-08-16

This record intentionally contains alert metadata only. Secret values, locations,
and other credential material must never be copied into issues, pull requests, or
this repository.

## Repository controls

The following GitHub repository controls were enabled and verified through the
repository API:

- Dependabot vulnerability alerts
- Secret scanning
- Secret scanning push protection

Dependabot automated security fixes are disabled. Renovate remains the sole
dependency update service.

Secret scanning validity checks and non-provider patterns remain unavailable for
this user-owned public repository. GitHub restricts those controls to eligible
organization-owned repositories with GitHub Secret Protection ([availability
reference](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/secret-security/supported-secret-scanning-patterns)),
so API requests to enable them leave their status disabled.

## Alert triage

Secret scanning reported zero current or historical alerts after enablement. No
credential was found, so no credential required revocation.

Dependabot reported 51 open npm advisory records before remediation: 2 critical,
26 high, 20 moderate, and 3 low. All originated in the Docusaurus documentation
toolchain. Refreshing the lockfile and overriding `serialize-javascript` to its
patched 7.1.0 release reduced `npm audit` from 47 vulnerable dependency paths to
20: 0 critical, 17 high, 3 moderate, and 0 low. `npm ci` and the production
Docusaurus build pass with the override.

Two underlying transitive packages remain:

- `image-size` 2.0.2: high severity,
  [GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr) and
  [GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq);
  no patched release is available.
- `uuid` 8.3.2 through `sockjs`: moderate severity,
  [GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq);
  replacing it requires an upstream `webpack-dev-server`/Docusaurus update or an
  unsafe major-version override.

Both packages are build-time dependencies. The documentation deployment workflow
runs only after reviewed changes reach `main`; it does not build untrusted pull
request content. Renovate remains the sole dependency update service and will
surface a safe upstream remediation when one becomes available.
